svg.title: Using sites from the command line
svg.desc: Named sites that are already signed in return at once (exit 0) and open nothing. Otherwise the window opens each login page in turn and the command returns once all are signed in; it exits 3 if the window is closed first and 2 after --timeout (default 900 seconds). The profile's daemon shows the window, so other commands keep working meanwhile. An unknown name exits 64 and lists the names it knows. With no sites file and no arguments, umbra sign-in exits 64 and explains how to name a URL instead.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
